name: Aegis
tagline: Scans your public footprint to show what personal data is exposed.

awards: Best Use of Hermes -- Nous Research

problem: Personal information is easily found online, the builder learned firsthand.
solution: A solo-built dashboard analyses public profiles and images with OCR and ML to surface exposure risks.
demo_moment: Team-described: run a scan and view the exposure telemetry.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of Hermes -- Nous Research” among 212 submissions.

lessons: Show people their own exposure to make privacy real.
